key_decisions.rationale: Keeps interrupted sentence and Paul's re-description of imprisonment.
key_decisions.before: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles—
key_decisions.after: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles—
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles—

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves conditional tone, entrusted administration, and recipients.
key_decisions.before: surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace given to me for you,
key_decisions.after: surely you have heard about the stewardship of God's grace that was given to me for you,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: if indeed you have heard of the stewardship of the grace of God that was given to me for you,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps revelation, mystery, and prior writing.
key_decisions.before: how the mystery was made known to me by revelation, as I wrote briefly before.
key_decisions.after: that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote briefly before.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote briefly before,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps comparison across generations and present revelation.
key_decisions.before: which was not made known to other generations as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit:
key_decisions.after: which was not made known to people in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to his holy apostles and prophets:

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves three co- compounds and equal participation.
key_decisions.before: the Gentiles are co-heirs, members of the same body, and co-participants in the promise in Christ Jesus through the good news.
key_decisions.after: the Gentiles are coheirs, members of the same body, and copartners in the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, members of the same body, and sharers in the promise in Christ Jesus through the good news.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps service, gift, grace, and power.
key_decisions.before: I became a servant of this good news according to the gift of God’s grace given to me through the working of his power.
key_decisions.after: I became a servant of this gospel according to the gift of God's grace given to me through the working of his power.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Of this I became a servant according to the gift of the grace of God given to me by the working of his power.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Paul's intensified self-description and mission.
key_decisions.before: To me, the least of all the holy ones, this grace was given: to announce to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
key_decisions.after: This grace was given to me, the very least of all the saints: to proclaim to the Gentiles the unsearchable wealth of Christ
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: To me, the very least of all the holy ones, this grace was given: to proclaim to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps universal disclosure, hidden duration, and Creator.

key_decisions.after: and to bring to light for everyone the administration of the mystery hidden for ages in God, who created all things.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and to bring to light for all what is the administration of the mystery hidden for ages in God who created all things,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves church as means, multicolored image, and heavenly powers.

key_decisions.after: This was so that now, through the church, God's richly varied wisdom might be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that through the church the manifold wisdom of God might now be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly places,

key_decisions.rationale: Renders the genitive as Christ's faithfulness and preserves access.

key_decisions.after: In him we have boldness and confident access through his faithfulness.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: in whom we have boldness and access with confidence through faith in him.
